themes.label: AI as concern of a privileged minority
themes.definition: AI invoked as a topic of a fortunate minority, contrasted with global poverty and hunger to highlight inequality.
themes.inclusion: Passages contrasting rich-world AI or technology debates with poverty, hunger or illiteracy elsewhere.
themes.exclusion: Passages about unequal access to AI tools or capacity (still digital divide but with access framing).
themes.boundary_cases: AI listed among rich-world concerns with no evaluation of AI itself should also be coded as a list mention.

examples.quote: while a fortunate minority in the world is discussing such issues as digital technology, robotics, artificial intelligence and obesity

themes.label: AI listed among rich-world topics
themes.definition: AI named in a list with digital technology, robotics and obesity without discussion of AI itself.
themes.inclusion: Passages where AI is a list item illustrating a broader argument.
themes.exclusion: Passages elaborating AI effects or governance.
themes.boundary_cases: Code with AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE when the list serves an inequality contrast.

examples.quote: digital technology, robotics, artificial intelligence and obesity

value.rationale: Single Turkish 2019 passage where AI is a list item used rhetorically to contrast privileged-minority concerns with mass poverty and hunger.
